name: Plaguebearer
summary: A pustule-ridden corpse that spreads sickness with every breath.
description: Plaguebearers walk out of mass graves from outbreaks no one recorded. Doctors say the rot does not need the claws; standing near one for a day is enough to start the fever.

understood: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Fever Aura
traits.text: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the plaguebearer must succeed on a {dc:con} Constitution saving throw or have the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition until the start of its next turn. A creature that succeeds is immune to this aura for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The plaguebearer makes two Rotting Fist attacks.

actions.name: Choking Miasma

save.targets: each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the plaguebearer

actions.onFailure: and the target has the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition until the end of its next turn.
